Andrew Edston: Young Chef
Andrew Edston is a 20-year-old chef with a great future. He recently won a competition called The Future Chef, for professional chefs in the part of the UK where he works. He's already taken part in various cooking contests but says this latest was the toughest. Even before it started, he knew he'd be competing against talented chefs. 16______ As he explains, he always enters competitions convinced he's going to win!
Although competitions can be enjoyable, cooking contests are not always just for fun. Restaurant owners often enter their young chefs into competitions as part of their training. This is what happened to Andrew. In the kitchen at Garden Tastes, the restaurant where he works, he is usually in charge of one course. 17______ Doing so has allowed him to gain important experience. The people judging the food are usually top food industry experts, which is extremely useful. Andrew gets to present his food to important people and hear their comments on every dish.
In fact, in the restaurant, it's more likely that customers wanting to speak to the chef will be complaining about a problem! And even when customers take the time to say they like something, it's not the same as hearing this from a food expert.
Andrew's already planning to enter a national cooking competition called Top Chef. If he gets to the final, he'll cook live on TV! It's a huge challenge, so he's getting advice from the other chefs at work. 19______ For one thing, it'll be good during the stressful training period to have their support. Everyone says he deserves success, knowing how much he puts into getting everything right. For example, one of the dishes Andrew's planning contains cheese. Rather than using something he'd cooked with before, he visited many farms and tasted hundreds of different cheeses. 20______ It's attention to details like this which he hopes will impress judges!

sentences.label: A
sentences.text: They all want to see him do well.

sentences.label: B
sentences.text: The ingredients are given to the chefs.

sentences.label: C
sentences.text: In contests, though, he plans a whole menu.

sentences.label: D
sentences.text: If the dish is popular, however, he cooks it again.

sentences.label: E
sentences.text: Having the opportunity to get opinions like this is rare.

sentences.label: F
sentences.text: He kept going until he'd found one with the perfect flavour.

sentences.label: G
sentences.text: That didn't stop him aiming high though.

sentences.label: H
sentences.text: He is expecting to be quite nervous.

explanations.16: Andrew 明知对手强大仍参赛，G 选项 “That didn't stop him aiming high though.”（但仍志在高远）转折并强调决心，与 “enters competitions convinced he'll win” 呼应。
explanations.17: Andrew 在餐厅负责一道菜，C 选项 “In contests, though, he plans a whole menu.”（但比赛中设计完整菜单）对比工作与比赛差异，与 “gain important experience” 衔接。
explanations.18: 评委多为行业专家，E 选项 “Having the opportunity to get opinions like this is rare.”（获此类意见机会难得）强调评委反馈价值，与 “hear their comments” 呼应。
explanations.19: Andrew 向同事请教，A 选项 “They all want to see him do well.”（同事都希望他成功）说明支持态度，与 “stressful training period” 衔接。
explanations.20: Andrew 尝数百种奶酪，F 选项 “He kept going until he'd found one with the perfect flavour.”（直到找到完美风味）描述坚持过程，与 “attention to details impress judges” 呼应。
